subject: Private deployment architecture review - VPC / on-prem / air-gapped requirements
messages:
From: Alex Williams <alex.williams@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Cloud Infra <acme-cloudinfra@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment architecture review - VPC / on-prem / air-gapped requirements

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the earlier conversation - we'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive to review Acme's private deployment requirements. We need to cover VPC peering options, on-prem deployment constraints, and air-gapped/offline install needs for a regulated environment. Goal is to align on what Redwood needs from our infra team and a high-level runbook for proof-of-concept.

Proposed agenda (30-45m):
- Introductions & objectives (5m)
- Network/topology constraints (VPC, NAT, peering) (10m)
- On-prem storage, KMS/HSM, and air-gapped install approach (10m)
- Integration points, logs/audit, and data residency (5-10m)

We are generally available next week. A few time options that work for our infra and security folks:
- Tue, Jun 22: 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed, Jun 23: 14:00-15:00 PT
- Thu, Jun 24: 09:00-10:00 PT

I've attached a short doc that outlines our initial requirements and constraints (acme-private-requirements.pdf). Please include any Redwood engineers or architects who should join.

Thanks,
Alex Williams
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme-private-requirements.pdf (application/pdf, 482 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Williams <alex.williams@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment architecture review - VPC / on-prem / air-gapped requirements

Hi Alex -

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear agenda. We'd be happy to run the deep-dive next week. I can join as the technical lead and have looped in Vivek (runtime/ops) and Ben (solutions lead).

From our side, proposed slots that match our team's availability:
- Tue, Jun 22: 10:00-10:45 PT
- Tue, Jun 22: 11:00-11:45 PT
- Wed, Jun 23: 14:00-14:45 PT

If you prefer a slightly longer slot (60m) we can extend. Could you confirm who from Acme will join (network, infra, security)? Also if you have any topology diagrams beyond the attached doc, please send - that helps Vivek prep.

I've attached our private deployment checklist which covers pre-reqs we normally ask customers to confirm ahead of an architecture review.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Alex -

11:00 PT on Tue, Jun 22 works for us. I've finalized and sent a calendar invite to the attendees (link below). Vivek will cover network/topology and on-prem install considerations; I'll cover customer-facing deployment patterns and our checklist for air-gapped installs. Ben will own notes and follow-ups (POC plan, next steps).
